findings.message: Arrivals peak at different times of day than the synthetic profile. Every calendar feature and the whole arrival forecaster were tuned on that shape.
findings.name: arrival-hour shape

findings.message: The ESI mix differs from the synthetic profile. The priority queue, every per-acuity result and the per-acuity conformal calibration all depend on it.
findings.name: acuity mix

findings.message: Waits are on a different scale from the synthetic data. The 30-minute prolonged-wait threshold, the conformal interval widths and the simulation's fitted parameters were all chosen against that scale.
findings.name: median wait

findings.message: Patients leave without being seen at a different rate. That is the competing risk the survival models describe and the quantity the simulation's patience parameter is fitted to.
findings.name: LWBS rate

verdict: This dataset looks like the synthetic data the models were tuned on, across all 4 comparisons. That is reassuring about the shape of the data and says nothing about whether the models are any good on it -- they have still never been validated on real data.
